title_zh: 副校长下场撮合，笔试第一被第二花钱劝弃考，广东雷州启动问责
title_en: Vice Principal Mediates as Top Scorer Paid to Withdraw from Exam, Leizhou Launches Accountability Investigation
summary_zh: 广东雷州发生考试违规事件，副校长介入撮合，笔试第一名被第二名花钱劝弃考，当地已启动问责。
summary_en: In Leizhou, Guangdong, an exam violation occurred where a vice principal mediated and the top scorer was paid to withdraw by the second-place candidate; local authorities have launched accountability proceedings.
